source_title: addozhang/leancast: Ad-free DLNA / UPnP cast receiver for Android TV · 极简无广告投屏接收器 - GitHub
source_excerpt:
Download APK · Supported devices · Report device compatibility
A minimal, ad-free DLNA/UPnP cast receiver for Android TV. Open any video app with a cast button (Bilibili, iQiyi, Tencent Video, Youku, Quark, …), pick this receiver, and the video plays fullscreen with hardware decoding — no ads, no accounts, no cloud.
Standard UPnP AV MediaRenderer:1 — SSDP discovery, AVTransport / RenderingControl / ConnectionManager SOAP control, and real GENA eventing (initial LastChange on subscribe, then a notification per state change).
Hardware decoding via Media3/ExoPlayer: HLS ( .m3u8 ), progressive MP4, Matroska, HTTP-FLV (best effort), HTTP↔HTTPS redirects, cleartext LAN URLs.
TV-native controls & OSD : OK = pause/resume, ◀ ▶ = seek with an escalating fast-forward ladder (10 s → 5 min while held) , ▼ = cycle playback speed (0.75x / 1.0x / 1.25x / 1.5x / 2.0x) , ▲ = reveal OSD, Back = exit; on-screen HUD with live progress bar, media title, and seek/speed feedback in English or Chinese.
Lean & private : lighter than the stock TV launcher (see below); zero analytics, zero non-LAN network calls; pure-Kotlin APK with no native libs — one artifact runs on armeabi-v7a , arm64-v8a , x86 , x86_64 .
Nothing hardcoded : the cast name defaults to LeanCast and is user-renamable; UUID is derived from the device id, so it survives reboots and reinstalls ; UI language switchable between 简体中文 and English.
Tested on an Amazon Fire TV (Fire OS 7 / Android 9, 32-bit MTK SoC) with minSdk 21 / targetSdk 28 .
LeanCast is a pure-Kotlin APK with no native libraries and minSdk 21 (Android 5.0, 2014), so a single artifact covers armeabi-v7a , arm64-v8a , x86 and x86_64 . Decoding uses each device's platform MediaCodec , so codec coverage follows the device: H.264 everywhere, HEVC/4K on 2016+ TVs, AV1 only on newer boxes.
Phone "system cast" (Miracast) is out of scope — LeanCast is a DLNA/UPnP receiver, so use the [TV] button inside video apps.
Brand alone does not establish compatibility: operating systems vary by model and region. Native Tizen, webOS, Roku OS, VIDAA and other non-Android systems cannot run this APK; an external Android TV box can be used instead.
These are specific developer or community test reports, not guarantees for every model from a brand. Unreported versions are left unknown; testing a feature does not imply every feature or sender app was tested.
Does LeanCast work on your TV, box or projector? Submit a device compatibility report . The bilingual form includes major brands and OS families; unknown firmware / Android versions are optional, and unsuccessful results are welcome too. If you use an external box, report the box running LeanCast. Reviewed reports will be added here with contributor credit.
Download the latest LeanCast- .apk from GitHub Releases ; building from source is optional.
Allow installation from unknown sources on your TV / box, install the APK, and open LeanCast.
Connect your phone and receiver to the same LAN. Tap [TV] inside a video app and select LeanCast.
You can rename the receiver, switch UI language, and enable Start on boot in the app.
Seeking and speed changes are disabled on live streams. Each new cast resets speed to 1.0x.

Development follows OpenSpec ( openspec/ ) with strict TDD: every spec scenario maps to unit tests in domain ; run them with ./gradlew :domain:test . End-to-end verification drives a real device from a dev box:
Two GitHub Actions workflows ship with the repo:
CI ( .github/workflows/ci.yml ) — runs domain unit tests + debug build on every push to main and every PR; uploads the debug APK as an artifact.
Release ( .github/workflows/release.yml ) — triggered by pushing a v* tag (or manually via workflow_dispatch ). Builds the release APK, runs the unit tests, creates a GitHub Release with auto-generated notes, and attaches LeanCast- .apk .
